description:
Fetch one saved strategy in full -- its entry and exit signals, asset, timeframe and status. Accepts either strategy_id or name. Use it before discussing or changing a specific strategy so you describe what is actually stored rather than what was said earlier in the conversation.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

name.description: Its name, if the id is unknown.

name: get_strategy
